title: NUANCE Center
content:
Aerogel University Research Platform. The NUANCE Center (Northwestern University Atomic and Nanoscale Characterization Experimental Center) in Evanston, Illinois, is Northwestern's core multi-user characterization facility, providing 24/7 open access to state-of-the-art analytical instrumentation for the university community and external partners.

Its integrated facilities span electron microscopy (EPIC), surface analysis with XPS and ToF-SIMS (Keck-II), micro-fabrication (NUFAB), and cryogenic and soft-matter characterization. With expert staff and training, NUANCE supports imaging and analysis of nanostructured and porous materials, making it a strong resource for aerogel morphology, composition, and surface-chemistry studies.
